Hi /v/food! With the summer fast approaching, I wanted to get some ideas for lighter flavored dishes for the warmer weather coming up. I don't mean "lighter" as in less fat, but rather in terms of flavor and texture. I like to think I can make some semi-decent food, but I have a pretty limited repertoire when it comes to lighter flavored dishes. Some of that might be technique, but when I think about it I really know how to make a lot more "heavy" foods(thick soups, heavy sauces, red meat, eggs, root vegetables, pasta, etc)

Let's share some of our favorite hot weather dishes, and I'll post the results when I make a few of them!
Ideas for "lighter" dishes for the hotter months?

For a throwback dessert:

Mix a container of cool whip with a little bit of powdered orange jello mix (just a little to give it color and a mild taste). Then mix in some pineapple bits. Serve. Straight up 1970's childhood summer goodness.
